nodes.label: Bot Middleware Chain Order
nodes.rationale: Middleware must be wired in exact order: session → conversations → userSyncMiddleware → handlers. Session must precede conversations plugin requirement.

nodes.label: Admin Silent Drop Pattern
nodes.rationale: Non-admin updates hitting admin handlers are silently dropped without error messages. Callback queries always answered to clear Telegram loading indicator even when dropped.

nodes.label: Persian User-Facing Strings Policy
nodes.rationale: All text shown to Telegram users must be in Persian (fa-IR). Code comments and log messages remain in English.

nodes.label: Adapters Interfaces-Only Pattern
nodes.rationale: src/adapters/ contains interfaces and types only — no implementations yet. Implementations go in the same directory alongside interfaces when ready.
